_comment: Canonical pack-store catalogue for Defenders of the Realm. The five purchasable packs, extracted VERBATIM from docs/monetization-v2-spec.md §4 (pricing ladder), §5.1 (cosmetic layer), §5.2 (economy layer), §5.3 (convenience layer) and §8.4 (PackDef schema). Pack names are canon — copy verbatim, never paraphrase. Mirrors the React v1 PackDef interface (src/content/packs.ts) so both engines read the same source of truth. Devnet-only economy in the v2 Unity foundation (v2-unity-port-spec.md Part 10).

_schemaNotes.packDef: Each entry mirrors React's PackDef: sku, tier, name, tagline, pricing { usd, usdc, sol, skr }, contents { cosmetics, economy, convenience }, founderOnly?, packExclusiveCosmetic. The Unity loader deserializes each entry straight into a PackDef record.
_schemaNotes.pricing: usd is the Stripe/USD reference price; usdc/sol/skr are the per-currency wallet-rail amounts set ONCE at v1 launch and held until v1.1 review (the SKR-fixed pricing strategy, §4). The Unity wallet module reads sol/usdc/skr only — Stripe is web-only and out of scope for the Unity port.
_schemaNotes.convenience: Convenience items are TIME-SAVING only, never combat-power (the bent covenant, §5.3). instant-build / instant-repair / harvest-auto-collect / xp-weekend. No permanent passives.
_schemaNotes.economy: In-game currency top-ups (§5.2). The Unity port's GameState resource wallet tracks crystals/food/coins; glimmer is a cosmetic-shop currency not yet modelled in the v2 foundation GameState and is carried here for catalogue completeness.
_schemaNotes.founderOnly: Founder's Vow (tier 5) is launch-window-only — gated by Date.now() < FOUNDER_WINDOW_END in React; the Unity port reads founderOnly and the owner gates the launch window.

currencyDisclaimer: Token price moves with the market.
